scripts.start:all: sh -c "pnpm run start:db && ./scripts/wait-for-db.sh && concurrently -k \"pnpm run frontend:dev\" \"pnpm run backend:dev\""
scripts.preview:all: sh -c "pnpm run start:db && ./scripts/wait-for-db.sh && concurrently -k \"pnpm run frontend:preview\" \"pnpm run backend:dev\""
scripts.backend:build: cd apps/backend && go build -o bin/lsd main.go
scripts.db:reset: pnpm run stop:db && pnpm run start:db && sleep 5 && pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm run start:db && sleep 5 && pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.setup:full: pnpm install && pnpm run start:db && sleep 5 && pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.stop:all: sh -c "pnpm run stop:db || true; pkill -f 'nuxt' || true; pkill -f 'vite' || true; pkill -f 'go run main.go' || true"
scripts.clean: pnpm run --recursive clean && pnpm run clean:dist
